title: NAILS deactivate --json
description: Machine-readable deactivate envelope (contract version 2): exactly one document on stdout with schema_version, command, ok, and either data or error. It reports the outcome: a success is printed only once the power-off is enqueued, so a failure to enqueue it is the one document (ok false, exit 1) and never follows a success. The power-off then stops every program of the hidden session, the reader included, so a reader stopped first may not read the success. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9. A declined prompt, or Ctrl+C at it, is the shared cancel shape: an error with the code `cancelled`, no data, exit 130; once the power-off has begun, a signal no longer stops it. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.

status.description: `poweroff_requested`: a hidden session ends in a power-off. `return_requested` is no longer sent.

warnings.description: Kept for older readers; a power-off has nothing to warn of, so it is absent.

backend_left_open.description: Kept for older readers; a deactivation marks no device now, so it is absent.
